invariant: A valid package or symbol-container opening line is one atomic ownership event. CommandPackage and CommandPackageWithUSymbol first resolve one Quark from the declaration identity, then CucaDiagram#gotoGroup creates or reuses the Entity on that Quark and pushes that same group as the current scope. Every following child declaration resolves below the current Quark until the matching closing brace. Quark.parent is therefore the sole parent-container identity returned by Entity#getParentContainer. Quark children use LinkedHashMap order and Plasma registers Quarks in creation order, so Entity#leafs/#groups and GraphvizImageBuilder#printGroups/#printGroup traverse direct leaves and child groups in source-derived Quark order. printGroup opens exactly one Cluster for each non-empty child group, emits its direct leaves, recursively emits child groups, and closes that Cluster. Whether the visible outline came from skinparam packageStyle or from an explicit symbol keyword does not alter this ownership model: CommandPackage may leave Entity.getUSymbol null and ClusterDecoration then falls back through PackageStyle#toUSymbol, while CommandPackageWithUSymbol installs an explicit USymbol before the same group traversal. A Java stereotype capture may contain several consecutive <<...>> spans. StereotypePattern's anchored regex can capture the complete sequence, Stereotype#build retains it as one value, and StereotypeDecoration#cutLabels extracts every visible label in declaration order. Multiple stereotypes therefore remain metadata on one successfully created group; they never cancel the group or its scope.
causal_divergence: Rust's ClassParser#try_package separates the identity regex from MODIFIERS_RE, but MODIFIERS_RE permits only one trailing stereotype span with << followed by characters excluding the first >. All five independent follow-up inputs place two visible stereotypes on one package opening line. RE captures the identity and leaves both stereotypes in the modifier tail; MODIFIERS_RE then fails, try_package returns false at lines 1281-1284, and parse_line silently ignores the otherwise valid opener. Because no Package is inserted, no canonical package path is registered, and no package index is pushed on package_stack, the following classes resolve through current_group_path to the surrounding package or root. The renderer then receives a self-consistent but incomplete tree: Package.parent, package_render_model roles, SvekEmissionOrder traversal, cluster construction, and qualified-name emission all correctly reflect the missing parser owner. This explains both manifestations in the rejection record. A root declaration produces top-level children and no cluster; a nested declaration produces children owned directly by the surrounding group and no intermediate cluster. The explicit-versus-fallback alternation is incidental: in each pair, the declaration that disappears is exactly the declaration carrying two stereotypes, independent of symbol family, packageStyle fallback, nesting, direction, or source position.
planned_change: Replace the one-slot package modifier match with a structured package-opening parser that consumes the complete Java-shaped modifier sequence and collects every <<...>> span in source order, including consecutive labels in the pre-AS identity slot and in the post-identity stereotype slot. Treat parsing and scope creation transactionally: once the complete valid opening line is recognized, resolve exactly one canonical group path, create or update exactly one Package/Quark record, preserve all visible stereotype labels in Package.stereotypes, record its explicit symbol kind or packageStyle-fallback kind without changing ownership, and push that package index before parsing children. Keep Package.parent authoritative and leave package_render_model, direct-child role calculation, cluster traversal, and layout geometry unchanged except for consuming the corrected parser tree. Add parser-level assertions for canonical child paths and parent indices before any SVG comparison, then verify held-out root/nested and reordered cases across packageStyle fallback and explicit node/database/frame/rectangle/cloud forms. Do not add symbol-family branches, fixture names, coordinate adjustments, or renderer-side reconstruction of missing owners.

scope_boundary: This account supersedes a renderer-header explanation for these five failures. The existing header-separation implementation remains relevant to clusters that survive parsing, but it cannot run for a declaration discarded before group materialization. This mechanism changes parser ownership data only; any residual symbol header geometry after ownership is restored remains under class-package-style-header-separation.
